content.text: The text combines several works. In a Civil War narrative, Major Brice travels from Goldsboro to City Point, meets Grant and Lincoln, and accompanies Lincoln to Richmond and Washington. Virginia Carvel travels from St. Louis to Washington, where Lincoln pardons her cousin Colfax; she later visits ancestral Annapolis with Stephen Brice. A separate adventure follows the Flying Machine Boys from Quito toward Peru and Lake Titicaca. Sam, Jimmie, and Carl fly the _Ann_ to a haunted temple, are trapped with jaguars, escape through underground passages, and reunite with their party. Havens and the boys later travel by air to an Andean fortress, capture embezzler Milo Redfern, and return toward Quito. The remaining articles discuss photography, chemistry, soap, nutrition, medicine, surveying, agriculture, machinery, trees, birds, stone, solar heat, and other scientific subjects.
